\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:intro}

This document exists so the compile pipeline has something small and boring to
chew on. It deliberately uses only what every TeX distribution ships, so it
compiles identically under Tectonic and under a system engine.

\section{Some Mathematics}

Section~\ref{sec:intro} said nothing interesting, so here is Euler's identity:

\begin{equation}
  e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0.
\end{equation}

And an inline fragment, $\alpha + \beta = \gamma$, to exercise inline maths.

\section{A List}

  \item Mathematics, to exercise font loading.
  \item Nothing else.
\end{itemize}
